exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. 1 Where is Dr Dolittle? 2 Why is the dog there?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. 1 Doktor Dulittl qayerda? 2 It nega u yerda?
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM HAQIDA: 'Dr Dolittle' (1998,
  Eddie Murphy). Shifokor John
  Dolittle bolaligida hayvonlar
  bilan gaplasha olardi. Kattalikda
  bu qobiliyat qaytadi - u itni
  mashina bilan urib yuborgach.
  Hayvonlar unga yordam so'rab
  kela boshlaydi.

  CHAP SURAT: Dr Dolittle VETERINAR
  KLINIKADA. It (Lucky) stolda -
  Dolittle uni mashina bilan urib
  yuborgan, shuning uchun olib
  kelgan.


⚠ 'A VET':

  = veterinar (hayvon shifokori).

tasks.en: He is at the vet's (in a veterinary clinic).
Dr Dolittle hit the dog with his car, so he has brought it to the vet.

exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 A DOG - Lucky'ni mashina bilan
    uradi
  2 A GUINEA PIG - Rodney,
    qizining dengiz cho'chqasi
  3 WING - boyo'g'li qanotini
    jarohatlagan
  4 RATS - axlat qutisidan
    yeyayotgan kalamushlar
  5 SPANISH - orangutan ispancha
    gapiradi
  6 LUCKY - daydi itning ismi


⚠ 'A STRAY DOG':

  = daydi it.


⚠ 'A GUINEA PIG':

  = dengiz cho'chqachasi.

tasks.prompt: John Dolittle hit ___ with his car.
tasks.promptUz: Jon Dulittl mashinasi bilan itni urib yubordi.

tasks.prompt: The owl came to Dr Dolittle because it had hurt its ___.
tasks.promptUz: Boyo'g'li qanotini jarohatlagani uchun Doktor Dulittlga keldi.

tasks.prompt: ___ were eating from the rubbish bin.
Dr Dolittle named the stray dog ___.
tasks.promptUz: Doktor Dulittl daydi itga Laki deb ism qo'ydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Rewrite the following in reported speech. 1 "I love you," John said to Lucky. 2 "I saved your life," Dolittle said to the rat. 3 "I've got to get help," Lucky said. 4 "I love nuts," said Rodney. 5 "Have you ever done this operation before?" the tiger asked Dr Dolittle.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagilarni ko'chirma gapga aylantiring. 1 "Seni yaxshi ko'raman," dedi Jon Lakiga. 2 "Men joningni saqlab qoldim," dedi Dulittl kalamushga. 3 "Yordam olishim kerak," dedi Laki. 4 "Yong'oqni yaxshi ko'raman," dedi Rodni. 5 "Bu operatsiyani ilgari qilganmisiz?" deb so'radi yo'lbars Doktor Dulittldan.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA GAP - 14-15-unit
  grammatikasi.

  Zamon BIR QADAM ORQAGA:
    love → loved
    saved → had saved
    've got to → had to
    Have you done → if he had done
  Olmosh: I → he; you → him/it.
  'said to Lucky' → 'told Lucky'.
  Savol: asked + if + ...


⚠ 'I'VE GOT TO' → 'HAD TO':

  Majburiyat o'tgan zamonda.

tasks.answer: 1 John told Lucky that he loved him.
tasks.speakAnswer: 1 John told Lucky that he loved him.

tasks.answer: 2 Dolittle told the rat that he had saved its life.
tasks.speakAnswer: 2 Dolittle told the rat that he had saved its life.

tasks.answer: 3 Lucky said that he had to get help.
tasks.speakAnswer: 3 Lucky said that he had to get help.

tasks.answer: 4 Rodney said that he loved nuts.
tasks.speakAnswer: 4 Rodney said that he loved nuts.

tasks.answer: 5 The tiger asked Dr Dolittle if he had ever done that operation before.
tasks.speakAnswer: 5 The tiger asked Dr Dolittle if he had ever done that operation before.

exercises.instructionEn: Tick which of the following animals came to Dr Dolittle's house: pig, duck, elephant, bear, goat, penguin, sheep, cow, chicken.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi qaysi hayvonlar Doktor Dulittlning uyiga kelganini belgilang: cho'chqa, o'rdak, fil, ayiq, echki, pingvin, qo'y, sigir, tovuq.
exercises.explanationUz:
DOLITTLE UYIGA KELGAN HAYVONLAR
  (o'ng suratga ham qarang):

  ✓ DUCK - o'rdak (suratda)
  ✓ GOAT - echki
  ✓ SHEEP - qo'y
  ✓ CHICKEN - tovuq (suratda stol
    ustida)
  ✗ pig, elephant, bear, penguin,
    cow - uyga kelmagan (fil, ayiq,
    pingvin uyga sig'maydi!)


⚠ Filmda uyga yana itlar,
  kaptarlar, kalamushlar ham
  keladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the picture. How many animals can you name?
exercises.instructionUz: Suratga qarang. Nechta hayvonning nomini ayta olasiz?
exercises.explanationUz:
O'NG SURAT: Dr Dolittle uyida
  hayvonlar orasida.

  Ko'rinadigan hayvonlar:
  • a Dalmatian (dog) - dalmatin
  • a big dog lying down - katta
    it (Lucky)
  • another dog (right) - o'ngda
    yana bir it
  • a duck - o'rdak
  • chickens / pigeons on the table
    - tovuq/kaptarlar


⚠ 'A DALMATIAN':

  = dalmatin (oq-qora dog'li it).

tasks.en: How many animals can you name in the picture?
tasks.uz: Suratda nechta hayvonning nomini ayta olasiz?

exercises.instructionEn: Write what happens at the end of the film to: 1 the 'swan' egg. 2 the tiger.
exercises.instructionUz: Film oxirida quyidagilarga nima bo'lishini yozing: 1 'oqqush' tuxumi. 2 yo'lbars.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM OXIRI.

  1 'SWAN' EGG - kalamushlar
    'oqqush tuxumi' deb olib kelgan
    tuxumdan oxirida JO'JA (tovuq
    bolasi) chiqadi - u oqqush emas
    edi.
  2 TIGER - Dr Dolittle sirkdagi
    yo'lbarsga operatsiya qiladi
    (miyasida qon quyilishi bor
    edi) va yo'lbars tuzalib
    ketadi.


⚠ 'TO HATCH':

  = tuxumdan chiqmoq.

tasks.en: 1 At the end of the film the 'swan' egg hatches and a chick comes out - it was a chicken's egg, not a swan's egg.
tasks.uz: 1 Film oxirida 'oqqush' tuxumidan jo'ja chiqadi - bu oqqush emas, tovuq tuxumi edi.

tasks.en: 2 Dr Dolittle operates on the tiger and saves its life. The tiger gets better.
tasks.uz: 2 Doktor Dulittl yo'lbarsga operatsiya qilib, jonini saqlab qoladi. Yo'lbars tuzalib ketadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Mark the sentences as T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
FILM FAKTLARI.

  1 F - Yo'lbars sakramoqchi edi,
    lekin tushkunlikdan emas -
    boshi qattiq og'rigani (kasal)
    uchun
  2 F - Dolittle'ning IKKI QIZI
    bor (Charisse va Maya)
  3 T - Otasi bolaligida u
    hayvonlar bilan gaplashishini
    bilardi (va buni to'xtatgan)
  4 T - Avvaliga hamma uni aqldan
    ozgan deb o'yladi
  5 F - Maya yozgi lagerni
    yoqtirmadi


⚠ 'DEPRESSED':

  = tushkun, ruhi tushgan.


⚠ 'CRAZY':

  = aqldan ozgan.

tasks.prompt: The tiger was going to jump because it was depressed.
tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Yo'lbars kasal edi (boshi qattiq og'rirdi), tushkunlik emas.
tasks.speak: The tiger was going to jump because it was depressed.

tasks.whyUz: ⚠ Uning ikki QIZI bor - Charisse va Maya.

tasks.prompt: Dolittle's father knew he could talk to animals.
tasks.speak: Dolittle's father knew he could talk to animals.

tasks.prompt: At first everyone thought Dr Dolittle was crazy.
tasks.speak: At first everyone thought Dr Dolittle was crazy.

exercises.instructionEn: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Would you like to be able to talk to animals? Why/Why not? 2 If you could keep an unusual pet, what would it be? 3 Do you think animals should be kept in zoos? Why/Why not?
exercises.instructionUz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Hayvonlar bilan gaplasha olishni xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q? 2 G'ayrioddiy uy hayvoni saqlay olsangiz, u nima bo'lardi? 3 Sizningcha, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlash kerakmi? Nega / nega yo'q?
exercises.explanationUz:
MUHOKAMA - 14-unit (Live and Let
  Live) mavzusi.

  1 'Yes, I would, because I could
    help sick animals.' / 'No,
    because they would never stop
    talking!'
  2 'If I could, I would keep a
    parrot / a snake / a monkey.'
  3 'Yes - zoos protect endangered
    animals.' / 'No - animals
    should live in the wild.'


⚠ 'AN UNUSUAL PET':

  = g'ayrioddiy uy hayvoni.

tasks.en: TOPICS FOR DISCUSSION: 1 Would you like to be able to talk to animals? Why/Why not? 2 If you could keep an unusual pet, what would it be? 3 Do you think animals should be kept in zoos? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: MUHOKAMA MAVZULARI: 1 Hayvonlar bilan gaplasha olishni xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q? 2 G'ayrioddiy uy hayvoni saqlay olsangiz, u nima bo'lardi? 3 Sizningcha, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlash kerakmi? Nega / nega yo'q?

tasks.en: Would you like to be able to talk to animals? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: Hayvonlar bilan gaplasha olishni xohlarmidingiz? Nega / nega yo'q?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'Yes, I would, because I could understand what my cat wants and help sick animals.' (Ha, chunki mushugim nima xohlashini tushunib, kasal hayvonlarga yordam berardim.)

tasks.en: If you could keep an unusual pet, what would it be?
tasks.uz: G'ayrioddiy uy hayvoni saqlay olsangiz, u nima bo'lardi?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'If I could, I would keep a monkey because monkeys are clever and funny.' (Imkonim bo'lsa, maymun saqlardim, chunki maymunlar aqlli va qiziqarli.)

tasks.en: Do you think animals should be kept in zoos? Why/Why not?
tasks.uz: Sizningcha, hayvonlarni hayvonot bog'ida saqlash kerakmi? Nega / nega yo'q?
tasks.note: Namuna: 'I think zoos are good because they protect endangered animals, but the animals need big, natural spaces.' (Menimcha, hayvonot bog'lari yaxshi, chunki ular yo'qolib borayotgan hayvonlarni himoya qiladi, lekin hayvonlarga katta, tabiiy joy kerak.)

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + told + KIMGA + (that) + KIM + O'TGAN ZAMON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: "I love you," John said to Lucky. → John told Lucky that he loved him.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: "Seni yaxshi ko'raman," dedi Jon Lakiga. → Jon Lakiga uni yaxshi ko'rishini aytdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + asked + KIMDAN + if + KIM + had + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The tiger asked Dr Dolittle if he had ever done that operation before.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lbars Doktor Dulittldan u operatsiyani ilgari qilgan-qilmaganini so'radi.

sentencePatterns.formula: If you could keep an unusual pet, what would it be?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: If I could keep an unusual pet, it would be a monkey.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: G'ayrioddiy uy hayvoni saqlay olsam, u maymun bo'lardi.
